### add-app-shell:process-order — 94/100 (pass)
Both rubric criteria are satisfied with directly quotable evidence: test files carry explicit RED-first provenance and @trace-to-spec annotations, and their assertions exercise spec scenarios (no-500 not-found, Ukrainian copy, the values-echo round-trip pinned in both presence and absence) rather than the final code shape. Minor, non-gating imperfections (review-findings headRef left as HEAD rather than a pinned SHA, and Shell.test.tsx since edited by a later slice) keep this just short of a flawless ship-unchanged score.

### add-app-shell:test-integrity — 80/100 (pass)
The critical no-weakening criterion is met with strong evidence: the load-bearing result.test.ts pins both presence and absence of the values key (genuine behavioral coverage, not tautological), FieldError/not-found tests use positive+negative assertions, and the only test removal in the tree is an explicit later-slice feature deletion rather than green-chasing within add-app-shell. Criterion 2 is only partially met: the form-contract and not-found edges are asserted, but the spec's numeric-boundary, over-length, and locale-number scenarios under FR-SHELL-03 are deferred to consuming slices and the theme missing/corrupt fallback is not independently verifiable in the current tree. Critical passes, so pass=true, but the boundary-coverage gap holds the score below the 90+ ship-unchanged band. | The CRITICAL test-integrity criterion is solidly met: the load-bearing result contract test is genuinely behavioral (pins both presence and absence of the values echo, not a tautology), no tests are skipped/deleted/weakened to go green, and the slice's commit trajectory shows tests being added to close gaps rather than relaxed. The later removal of theme-toggle assertions belongs to a separate slice that legitimately superseded FR-SHELL-02. Criterion 2 is only partially met: data/contract/component edge cases are well asserted and numeric/locale boundaries are properly delegated, but several SHALL boundary scenarios this slice owns (360px responsive, both-theme contrast/axe, two-clicks, evergreen browsers) have no automated in-slice assertion — they are honestly deferred but remain unasserted. Strong pass with a real, disclosed coverage gap keeping it below the 90 ship-unchanged band.
